CONTENT: 1️⃣ Preparation
Review the job description and role requirements
Confirm the evaluation criteria (communication clarity
Open the Willo dashboard and confirm all video submissions are received
Prepare a scoring sheet or note-taking format for each candidate
2️⃣ Video Review
Watch each candidate video in full without interruption
Log structured notes for each candidate immediately after watching
Note communication clarity and how well each candidate articulates answers
Note confidence and presentation style for each candidate
Note how relevant each candidate's responses are to the role requirements
3️⃣ Candidate Evaluation
Score each candidate against the agreed evaluation criteria
Flag any standout strengths or significant concerns per candidate
Re-watch any responses where you are uncertain about a score
Rank candidates by overall evaluation score
Identify any candidates who require a second reviewer
4️⃣ Shortlisting
Categorise each candidate: shortlist / maybe / no progression
Review borderline (maybe) candidates for a final decision
Confirm the shortlist size against available interview slots
Share shortlist and evaluation notes with the hiring team
5️⃣ Follow-up Actions
Send rejection emails to no-progression candidates
Notify shortlisted candidates of their next steps
Schedule next-stage interviews for shortlisted candidates
Archive Willo submissions and evaluation notes
